 Cloudy and breezy start to the week with a soggy election day ahead 
 Sunshine to return this weekend 
 By DJ Baker Published : Nov. 2, 2026 at 11:24 AM CST | Updated : 6 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google Warm, cloudy and breezy Monday 
 Rain chances tonight through Wednesday 
 Cooler weather by the end of the week 
 (Rockford News First) - It’s been a cloudy and breezy day so far across the stateline with a few wind gusts already reaching 15 to 20 mph. These winds will continue to strengthen throughout the day, helping blow some warm air into the region. We’ll top out in the lower 60 this afternoon despite mostly cloudy skies. 
 Wind gusts this afternoon (DJ Baker) Cloudy next few hours (DJ Baker) With the strengthening winds this evening, temperatures will actually rise later tonight. I think we’ll reach our high point on the day just before midnight in the mid-60s. With this warm air, we also find some moist air. This will help ignite some shower development tonight. These showers will last on an off and on basis through the morning hours. 
 Wind gusts tonight (DJ Baker) Showers starting tonight (DJ Baker) Download the First Alert Weather app
 iPhone/iPad Android Click here for Interactive Radar
 Click here for Interactive Radar What’s Coming Up...
 Election Day is tomorrow, and it’s going to be an interesting one in terms of weather. We’ll have off and on showers throughout the day, with a dry slight around lunchtime. This would give a perfect chance to get out and head to the polls and not worry about getting rained on. 
 Dry pocket around lunchtime (DJ Baker) However, we will see some very strong wind gusts Tuesday afternoon with some gusts near 30 to 35 mph. This will drive some very warm air into the region with highs nearly 20 degrees above normal in the lower 70s. 
 Wind gusts Tuesday (DJ Baker) Election Day forecas t (DJ Baker) Rain is set to return tomorrow afternoon/evening as a cold front pushes across the region. This is our best chance for rain by far, with a few pockets of some steady rainfall possible. This round of rain will last through the evening and into the early stages of our Wednesday. 
 More rain Tuesday afternoon (DJ Baker) Dry weather expected Wednesday (DJ Baker) Looking Ahead...
 Once the rain stops on Wednesday, our rain chances will start to drop. High pressure will build in overhead, with a winds shifting to be more out of the northwest. This will bring our temperatures back down to the 50s, where we should be at for the rest of the week.
